standalone._radioDefaultsNote: RADIODEFAULTS-2026-10-06 (Fred, evaluation defaults): stopped -> a report every 30 s (STATIONARY30-2026-10-06: was 120 s, which tripped the 45 s link heartbeat on stationary radios); moving (smart) -> every 100 m, never more often than every 6 s; hop limit 2 (up to 4 radios, possibly out of direct range). Serial enabled and position flags are written and verified at check-in. The tiered table + ranges replace these later.
standalone._note: Standalone radios (T1000-E): ALL GPS/position settings a radio with no app needs (Fred 09-25). Moving: a report every 4 s once it has moved 20 m (smart; 4 s from 09-26); stationary: every 15 s. The GroupTrack default is the BASE; a ride overlays only network.mesh.
standalone._bluetoothNote: NOPIN-2026-10-04 (Fred): Bluetooth pairing with NO PIN -- a stored pairing cannot fall out of step with the radio.
